generatorSets.operatingHoursRollingWindow: 12-month rolling time period as determined at the end of each calendar month.
generatorSets.allowedOperatingModes: The permittee may operate each engine in FGEMGENS for no more than 100 hours per calendar year for the purpose of necessary maintenance checks and readiness testing, provided that the tests are recommended by Federal, State, or local government, the manufacturer, the vendor, the regional transmission organization or equivalent balancing authority and transmission operator, or the insurance company associated with the engine. Each engine in FGEMGENS may operate up to 50 hours per calendar year in non-emergency situations, but those 50 hours are counted towards the 100 hours per calendar year provided for maintenance and testing as provided in §60.4211(f)(2). Except as provided in §60.4211(f)(3)(i), the 50 hours per calendar year for non-emergency situations cannot be used for peak shaving or non-emergency demand response, or to generate income for the permittee to supply non-emergency power as part of a financial arrangement with another entity.
generatorSets.extractionNotes: No make/model or BHP provided in permit. Maximum heat input rating stated as 18.76 MMBtu/hr in summary table.
